# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Clergyman  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v4 c3 P10](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev. Ez  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>; Reverend Ez  <sub>[v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>; Mr. Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an unattractive young man with a large, gangly frame and elongated legs. He has flaxen, limp hair, large ears, green eyes, a wide mouth, and an impassioned, scholarly forehead.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

He possesses a delightful voice and a beautiful soul and nature. Joyful, bright, and full of humor, he frequently jokes and laughs, though he is deeply serious, gentle, and faithful when engaged in his sacred calling. He is dedicated to his work as a minister and prefers serving in mission churches in the slums.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P17](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0017), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

- To serve as a devoted minister in the Tanner Street slum mission church  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Ezra Hale studied theology at St. Columbia after graduating from Wexcombe. While managing the Point Prospect Mission Church during one summer, he met Cressida Lindsay at Prospect Point, and the two quickly became fast friends. Although he initially resisted becoming a clergyman, he embraced it as his true calling and delivered moving sermons. After finishing his studies at St. Columbia, he took over a small mission church on Tanner Street in the slums. He proposed to Cressida Lindsay and married her the following June, with Nell Harcourt acting as bridesmaid. By the time of Nell's wedding to Hugh, he and Cressida had children and traveled together to attend Nell's nuptials, where he offered a lauded wedding prayer.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_
